title: Ali ali hai zaban
body:
ali ali hai zaban par kabhi hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke zikr ko apni baqa samajhte hai
hum aap in ki fazilat ko kya samajhte hai
khuda samajhta hai ya mustafa samajhte hai
nahi samajhte jo in ko khuda samajhte hai
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda nahi hai magar wajhe kirdagaar to hai
ye do jahan mein khudayi ka aetbaar to hai
jahan mein doshe payambar ka sheh sawaar to hai
raza e haq pe unhe poora ikhtiyar to hai
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ohad ki jang mein dekhe ajab ajab kirdaar
kahin hai zikre shuja'at kahin hai zikre faraar
zameen se taaba falak hai ali ali ki pukaar
utar rahe hai malayek liye huwe talwaar
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
samajh saka na zamana maqam e ahlebait
kalaam haq hi samjhe kalaame ahlebait
jagah jagah pe sunao payame ahlebait
karo jahan mein raaij nizaam e ahlebait
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye wo nahi jinhe dunya khareed sakti hai
ye wo hai jinke tasadduq mein khalk palti hai
sune wo jinko mohabbat ali ki khalti hai
qadam se in ke shariyat nabi ki chalti hai
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ke saath jo rehte thay us zamane mein
wohi thay aale mohamed ka ghar jalane mein
kuch aise naam bhi shaamil hai is fasane mein
hijab aata hai ab tak hamay batane mein
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua e fatema zehra hai jab talak qayam
na ruk sakega kisi se hussain ka matam
sune zamana hai jab tak hamare dam mein dam
rakhenge yunhi buland hum hussain ka parcham
ali ali hai zaban par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kasar kisi ne na chodi hamay mitane mein
khuda hi apna muhafiz tha har zamane mein
ye rok tok hai kyun sheh ka gham manane mein
yazeed kya abhi zinda hai is zamane mein
ali ali hai zaban par...
author: Sachey Bhai
